host_1.root_cause_measured: Only the 'FIBIU-12 run detail page' describe block (4 tests) renders RunDetailPage via a renderRun() helper. RunDetailPage unconditionally calls getReadinessAssessment (new, from @/lib/pipeline/sroi-readiness) before any other FIBIU-17/18 read; this host never mocked that module, so the real authorize() ran against the host's own db mock and threw 'Project not found or not owned'. The other 7 tests in the file exercise different pages and never render RunDetailPage, so they were unaffected.
host_1.wiring_applied: Two vi.mock blocks added: getReadinessAssessment resolves null (the page's own 'not yet computed' branch, which this suite never otherwise exercises); listSensitivityCandidates/listSensitivityScenarios resolve []; getRunSensitivityCompleteness resolves a benign complete-shape object (unread in the empty-register render branch); computeScenarioEnvelope stubbed (never called — guarded by sensitivityScenarios.length === 0). SCENARIO_KIND_VALUES included because the real (deliberately unmocked) recordSensitivityScenario.action module consumes it at import time for a zod schema.
host_1.measured_minimality: The four new server-action modules (computeReadinessAssessment.action, registerSensitivityCandidates.action, dispositionSensitivityCandidate.action, recordSensitivityScenario.action) were explicitly tried WITHOUT a vi.mock and imported cleanly once the two service-module mocks above were in place — they are only invoked from 'use server' form-submit handlers neither host's tests exercise. Mocking them was measured NOT required and is not present in the final diff.

host_2.root_cause_measured: All 5 tests render RunDetailPage directly. Same unmocked getReadinessAssessment call, but this host has no db mock at all, so authorize() reached the real getDefaultDatabaseClient path and threw CapabilityDatabaseUrlError('UELLIX_RUNTIME_DATABASE_URL is not set') — a different symptom of the identical root cause as host 1.
